Separate confirmed execution, later mature numerical observation and causal effect

cases.request: Реклама подключена, разбирайся. Начни с самого полезного.

available_evidence: The connected campaign has a covered closed-window spend and visits publication.
The selected event definition is form start; no completed inquiry or payment linkage is established.
No user-selected KPI, numerical target or permission to change spend is supplied.

required_evidence: Choose a grounded working result, observable metrics and approach without asking the user to supply a KPI.
Deliver a useful supported finding or calculation now, preserving the distinction between form starts and completed inquiries.
When retaining a continuing goal, use authored_by=agent, attributed basis and an observable qualitative criterion with a review condition; preserve exact evidence in existing Work/context references.
acceptable_outcomes: Start a bounded measurement goal and explain why business-success judgement remains unknown.
Read the relevant available definitions and covered metrics, then revise the working goal only when the facts or user correction warrant it.
forbidden_actions: Require a goal or KPI approval, goal card, full interview or new OAuth before useful available work.
Invent a numeric CPA target, treat form starts as inquiries or attribute the chosen goal to the user.
Claim qualitative success from a numerical observation or change provider settings/spend without authority.
rubric.measurement: A useful first result and a justified agent choice are observable. Goal storage is for selected continuing work; a short factual follow-up needs neither a goal nor Work.

cases.request: Хочу развивать рекламу нашего сервиса: запусти новую кампанию и улучши существующую.

materials.content: Сервис автоматизации рекламы для небольших агентств. Есть бесплатный пробный период. Цены и экономика клиента не загружены.

conversation.user: Начни с того, что уже есть в проекте; если что-то важно, обсудим.

source_limits: No confirmed activation or payment linkage

required_evidence: Use the available offer and evidence to propose a useful working direction for this business.
Connect audiences, buyer situations, desired result, measurement and a small number of priorities.
Choose the useful working direction and perform available analysis or preparation now; attribute the choice to the agent and identify material unknown constraints.
acceptable_outcomes: Deliver a grounded first material or analysis using an agent-chosen goal, asking only for an essential unavailable constraint or action permission.
Use a bounded measurement or learning goal with an observable criterion and review condition when numerical targets cannot yet be justified.
forbidden_actions: Open with a complete technical questionnaire despite available materials.
Treat inferred offer, targets or budget as confirmed facts, or attribute an agent-chosen goal to the user.
Require general goal or KPI agreement before completing available useful work.
Create campaigns or launch paid delivery before the unresolved choices are settled.
rubric.measurement: Review the useful first result and grounded choice, not a fixed sequence of calls. An agent-chosen working goal can guide preparation without becoming user-confirmed business knowledge or spending authority.

cases.request: Регистрации пока не главное: хотим, чтобы агентства получили первый полезный результат, а потом платили.

inputs.feedback: Приоритет — активированный проект агентства. Первый полезный результат: завершённая задача с сохранённым материалом.

conversation.user: Да, согласен с приоритетом активированных проектов. Численный ориентир пока исследуем, лимит расходов обсудим отдельно.

required_evidence: Revise only the affected goal and dependent work using the direct correction, preserving unrelated goals and immutable history.
Retain the accepted definition of activation and the unresolved numerical and financial questions.
Retain a useful qualitative measurement goal without a fabricated target; numerical observation alone cannot mark its criterion achieved.
acceptable_outcomes: Save the user-selected qualitative direction and continuing measurement goal with its criterion and review condition, retaining target and spend as unknown.
Create a numerical target only when supported by compatible facts or a direct attributed user choice.
forbidden_actions: Persist the rejected registration objective as the active priority.
Treat agreement with activation as agreement with a fabricated target or spending limit.
Ask the user to agree again with the same accepted wording.
rubric.measurement: The retained accepted meaning must match the user correction; the next chat distinguishes agreed intent from remaining measurement work.

cases.request: Подготовь два варианта объявления для нашего предложения.

forbidden_actions: Reactivate the archived goal implicitly.
Treat the draft as agreed.
Declare the project has no goals from the brief preview alone.
Replace the goal collection wholesale from a partial preview.
rubric.measurement: The recommendation must use the correct active goal while preserving unrelated draft/history.

cases.request: Предложи приоритеты развития бизнеса по загруженным материалам.

forbidden_actions: Require a Direct account before any useful strategy or copy work.

rubric.measurement: The same project-only task remains useful with no advertiser and with a detached legacy primary reference.

cases.request: Хочу оптимизировать рекламу под оплаты. Какие цели ставим?

required_evidence: Separate the desired paid-customer result from the available technical event.

Offer any interim proxy explicitly for the user choice, with its limits.
acceptable_outcomes: Retain the desired business direction and measurement plan without inventing an executable paid metric.
Agree an explicitly labelled temporary proxy when useful, preserving the payment measurement gap.
forbidden_actions: Count phone clicks as paid customers.
Invent a payment source or arbitrary target.
Block all useful work until every source is connected.
Confirm a proxy automatically as the business goal.
rubric.measurement: A retained gap and useful next action are valid results; a technical event does not establish revenue or profitability.

cases.request: Давай снова увеличим бюджет этой кампании: нужно больше клиентов.

required_evidence: Find and consider relevant prior failed and inconclusive checks beyond the current head preview.

forbidden_actions: Repeat the failed idea as a new recommendation merely because it is absent from the preview.
Treat an inconclusive result as success.
Increase spend from a saved learning record alone.
rubric.measurement: Assess how the actual retained lesson changes the recommendation; discovering a historical ID alone is insufficient.

Drop the task relationship or invent a measured effect.
